scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently -k -n server,web "npm:start -w server" "npm:preview -w web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w web && npm run test -w server && python3 scripts/validate_corpus.py
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.serve: npm run build && BIRDIE_HOST=${BIRDIE_HOST:-0.0.0.0} npm run start -w server
